distribution: Static folder, root index.html, separate classic JavaScript, CSS and local asset pack.

tests.actualBrowserDoubleClick: not tested; browser control blocks file:// navigation

realWebRtc.method: Two Node PeerJS clients with Werift WebRTC implementation, public PeerJS signaling, same host/network; controlled authoritative positions for capture/collection/delivery fixtures. Not a browser test or cross-NAT test.

browser.method: In-app Chromium browser through normal HTTP preview, real UI interactions.
browser.sceneQa: Actual renderer with controlled fixtures: eight appearance support; three visible distinct characters and carts; grab/stab/throw and victim camera checked; capture camera clipping corrected.

performance.note: Observed on this machine with other browser tabs; not a performance guarantee.

limits: Cross-network residential/mobile NAT combinations not tested; no TURN relay configured.
The game uses the supplied GLB clip plus procedural motion, not an exact copy of the Roblox animation.
Local file bootstrap and packed asset bytes tested; actual double-click browser session not tested.
Client game code and assets are downloaded by the browser and cannot be kept secret.
